description: Unit tests for the CoalescingCertVerifier class in the net:: namespace, focusing on request coalescing, configuration changes, object lifetime safety, and observer forwarding.

classes.name: CoalescingCertVerifierTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing CoalescingCertVerifier behaviors.

classes.name: CertVerifierObserverCounter
classes.description: Observer class used to count CertVerifierChanged notifications.

methods.name: SyncCompletion
methods.description: Tests that synchronous certificate verification completes without issues.

methods.name: InflightJoin
methods.description: Verifies that multiple requests with identical parameters join into a single verification.

methods.name: DoesNotJoinAfterConfigChange
methods.description: Ensures requests with different configurations do not join.

methods.name: DoesNotJoinAfterUnderlyingVerifierChange
methods.description: Ensures requests do not join after the underlying verifier signals a change.

methods.name: ObserverIsForwarded
methods.description: Checks that verifier change notifications are forwarded to observers.

methods.name: DeleteSecondRequestDuringFirstCompletion
methods.description: Tests safe deletion of a second request during the first request's completion.

methods.name: DeleteVerifierDuringCompletion
methods.description: Ensures safe deletion of the verifier during request completion.

methods.name: DeleteRequestBeforeCompletion
methods.description: Tests safe deletion of a request before it completes.

methods.name: DeleteFirstRequestBeforeCompletionStillCompletesSecondRequest
methods.description: Ensures second request completes correctly after first is deleted.

methods.name: DeleteRequestDuringCompletion
methods.description: Tests safe deletion of a request during its completion callback.

methods.name: RunUntilIdle
methods.description: Utility to process all pending tasks in the message loop.
